skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Guarding Dawn and Dusk
skins.content: Persona 3 Reload Collaboration Outfit/Guarding Dawn and Dusk. The costume Yukari Takeba wore performing at the school drama festival. A Guard looks out from atop the white wall; the peaceful dusk is the reward she earned after a long journey.
skins.usage: The costume Yukari Takeba wore in the play.
skins.quote: Morning to evening, clouds drifting and winds turning, the white wall gathers countless warm little lives within it—and that is what we call a city.
